Observed in production on 2.1.296: word-wars pr-review runs had git ls-files, git ls-tree and git show denied while git diff and git log, which had prefix rules, ran. Check a claim about what runs with no rule against a real pr-review stream.jsonl, not a plain clone (where the .git segment makes the gate pass), and search \\u003Cproject\\u003E/tasks/_archive/*/runs
